invariants_across_settings: infer the axis-aligned square from the same four gray cells
use the absent square corner as the triangle apex
preserve every gray clue and all cells outside the selected triangle
paint only orange background cells with color 8
change only boundary-only versus full-triangle rendering
limits: Bounded evidence for outline seed 18 and solid seed 19, not production approval.
The selected generator and canonical authority remain fixed to outline.
The demonstrations distinguish only the declared outline/solid rival.
Malformed grids and other hidden rule families remain outside this prototype.

parameter.input_constraints: Same selected-generator grammar: orange background, three square-corner gray clues, and one strictly interior gray distractor. Side length must leave at least one non-gray strict interior cell so demos distinguish outline from solid.
parameter.name: render_mode

outline.racket_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Exactly four gray cells are present: three square-bbox corners and
         ;; one interior distractor. The bbox extremes identify the square.
         (marks (find-color g 5))
         (r0 (min-of fst marks))
         (r1 (max-of fst marks))
         (c0 (min-of snd marks))
         (c1 (max-of snd marks))
         (d (- r1 r0))
         (tl? (= (at g r0 c0) 5))
         (tr? (= (at g r0 c1) 5))
         (bl? (= (at g r1 c0) 5))
         ;; The absent bbox corner determines the triangle orientation.
         (missing (cond ((not tl?) 0)
                        ((not tr?) 1)
                        ((not bl?) 2)
                        (else 3))))
    ;; Paint only orange background cells, preserving all four gray clues.
    (define (paint-if-bg acc r c)
      (if (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (= (at acc r c) 7))
          (set-cell acc r c 8)
          acc))
    (define (paint-h acc r ca cb)
      (reduce (lambda (a c) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ca (+ cb 1))))
    (define (paint-v acc c ra rb)
      (reduce (lambda (a r) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ra (+ rb 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-down acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (+ c0 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-up acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (- c1 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    ;; Draw the two square sides incident to the missing corner and the
    ;; diagonal joining the other two present corners.
    (cond
      ((zero? missing)
       (paint-diag-up (paint-v (paint-h g r0 c0 c1) c0 r0 r1)))
      ((= missing 1)
       (paint-diag-down (paint-v (paint-h g r0 c0 c1) c1 r0 r1)))
      ((= missing 2)
       (paint-diag-down (paint-v (paint-h g r1 c0 c1) c0 r0 r1)))
      (else
       (paint-diag-up (paint-v (paint-h g r1 c0 c1) c1 r0 r1)))))))

solid.racket_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Exactly four gray cells are present: three square-bbox corners and
         ;; one interior distractor. The bbox extremes identify the square.
         (marks (find-color g 5))
         (r0 (min-of fst marks))
         (r1 (max-of fst marks))
         (c0 (min-of snd marks))
         (c1 (max-of snd marks))
         (d (- r1 r0))
         (tl? (= (at g r0 c0) 5))
         (tr? (= (at g r0 c1) 5))
         (bl? (= (at g r1 c0) 5))
         ;; The absent bbox corner determines the triangle orientation.
         (missing (cond ((not tl?) 0)
                        ((not tr?) 1)
                        ((not bl?) 2)
                        (else 3))))
    ;; Paint only orange background cells, preserving all four gray clues.
    (define (paint-if-bg acc r c)
      (if (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (= (at acc r c) 7))
          (set-cell acc r c 8)
          acc))
    (define (paint-h acc r ca cb)
      (reduce (lambda (a c) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ca (+ cb 1))))
    (define (paint-v acc c ra rb)
      (reduce (lambda (a r) (paint-if-bg a r c))
              acc
              (range ra (+ rb 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-down acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (+ c0 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    (define (paint-diag-up acc)
      (reduce (lambda (a k) (paint-if-bg a (+ r0 k) (- c1 k)))
              acc
              (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    ;; Fill the triangle selected by the same missing-corner inference.
    (define (local-r u)
      (if (or (= missing 0) (= missing 1))
          (+ r0 u)
          (- r1 u)))
    (define (local-c v)
      (if (or (= missing 0) (= missing 2))
          (+ c0 v)
          (- c1 v)))
    (define (paint-solid acc)
      (reduce
        (lambda (a u)
          (reduce
            (lambda (b v)
              (if (<= (+ u v) d)
                  (paint-if-bg b (local-r u) (local-c v))
                  b))
            a
            (range 0 (+ d 1))))
        acc
        (range 0 (+ d 1))))
    (paint-solid g))))
